title: Tensor product of K-flat complexes is K-flat
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space. If $\mathcal K^\bullet$ and $\mathcal L^\bullet$ are K-flat complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex], then $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^\bullet)$ is a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.

proof.text: Let $\mathcal M^\bullet$ be any acyclic complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Since $\mathcal K^\bullet$ is K-flat, the total complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal K^\bullet)$ is acyclic by the definition of K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex].

Apply K-flatness of $\mathcal L^\bullet$ to the acyclic complex from Step 1. The definition of the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] gives the canonical associativity isomorphism $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^\bullet))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal M^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal K^\bullet)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^\bullet)$, with the Koszul signs agreeing. The right-hand side is acyclic, so the left-hand side is acyclic. As this holds for every acyclic $\mathcal M^\bullet$, the displayed total tensor complex is K-flat by [def-pc-kflat-complex].
